mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playback_progress (user_id, source_key, source_url, platform, title, format_id, mode, position_seconds, duration_seconds, completed, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{p.userId}, #{p.sourceKey}, #{p.sourceUrl}, #{p.platform}, #{p.title}, #{p.formatId}, #{p.mode}, #{p.positionSeconds}, #{p.durationSeconds}, #{p.completed}, #{p.createdAt}, #{p.updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE playback_progress SET source_url = #{p.sourceUrl}, platform = #{p.platform}, title = #{p.title}, format_id = #{p.formatId}, mode = #{p.mode}, position_seconds = #{p.positionSeconds}, duration_seconds = #{p.durationSeconds}, completed = #{p.completed}, updated_at = #{p.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{p.id} AND user_id = #{p.userId} AND deleted = 0
